# The Elo gauntlet's anchors (owner, 2026-10-31), built on GitHub's runners from
# their official sources at the pinned commits (tools/gauntlet/build_anchor.sh).
# Ratings: CCRL Blitz 2'+1", single-CPU entries, list of 2026-10-31
# (computerchess.org.uk/ccrl/404/); repositories, commits, licences and build
# commands checked by the research agent on 2026-10-31 from each project's
# README, LICENSE and build files (no engine source opened).
# Roles: continuity (the earlier gauntlets' anchors), new, alternate (replaces
# a new anchor whose build fails, in this order).
# Columns, tab-separated: name, file stem, CCRL Blitz, role, repository,
# commit, build folder, build command ("make ARGS" or "cmake TARGET"), fallback
# make arguments (or -), UCI options for fastchess (or -).
